gaps.lead: People claim that this herbal tea cures colds.
gaps.explanation: X is claimed to + infinitive = people claim X does.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be lying on a beach right now.
gaps.sentence: I ___ lying on a beach right now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past subjunctive: I wish I were (formal 'were', not 'was').

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: He finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: Jogging every morning was completely normal for him.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be accustomed to.

gaps.lead: My advice is to check the contract twice before signing.
gaps.sentence: You ___ the contract twice before signing.
gaps.explanation: had better + infinitive without 'to' = strong advice.
